Healing Tempo.phrase: Rejuvenating Aurora's heal counts as applying healing, so everyone it heals gets 35% fire rate and +1.25m/s move speed for 7s (innate regen and lifesteal do not trigger it).
Healing Tempo.note: ASSUMPTION flagged for review: aura healing (HealingPerSecond) is treated as 'applying healing'; item text only excludes innate regen and passive lifesteal. Not engine-tested.

Warp Stone.phrase: Singularity is centred on you (no cast range, 7m pull), so the 11m teleport is how you land inside the group before channelling; the 30% bullet resist lasts 6s, longer than the whole channel.

Enchanter's Emblem.phrase: Its +15 spirit and 5% cooldown reduction only count above 65% health, which fits a healer who is not being focused but is lost once you are dived.
Enchanter's Emblem.note: The 'fits a healer' clause is interpretation; kept below the publish threshold on purpose to show the gate working.
